answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a per-identity bond plus a commit-reveal lottery. To hold N identities an attacker must post N independent bonds and pass N time-seeded proof-of-work challenges, so cost scales linearly while payout does not. The seed comes from a public quartz timing beacon; a prism-style split of that stream exposes clones sharing the same fingerprint jitter, and a yarrow-thin quorum of honest validators is enough to slash any duplicated work receipt.
